query.esql:
FROM logs-corelight.dns*
| WHERE observer.vendor=="Corelight" 
    AND observer.hostname IS NOT NULL
    AND event.dataset LIKE "dns*"
    AND NOT (COALESCE(source.ip IN ("0.0.0.0","255.255.255.255"), false) OR COALESCE(destination.ip IN ("0.0.0.0","255.255.255.255"), false)
)
    AND dns.response_code == "NXDOMAIN"
    AND dns.response_code IS NOT NULL
| STATS  COUNT() BY source.ip, destination.ip
// stats by event.ids
| RENAME `COUNT()` AS `Top Non-Existent Domains`
| KEEP `Top Non-Existent Domains`

FROM logs-corelight.dns*
| WHERE event.dataset  == "dns_agg"
| STATS count = COUNT()
| EVAL `DNS Aggregation` = CASE(count > 0, "DNS Agg Logs Available", "No DNS Agg Logs"),
    status = CASE(count > 0, 1, 0)
| KEEP `DNS Aggregation`, status

FROM logs-corelight.dns*
| WHERE event.dataset  == "dns_agg"
| STATS count = COUNT()
| EVAL `DNS Aggregation` = CASE(count > 0, "DNS Agg Logs Available", "No DNS Agg Logs"),
    status = CASE(count > 0, 1, 0)
| KEEP `DNS Aggregation`, status

from logs-corelight.dns*
| limit 10000
| where observer.vendor == "Corelight"
    and event.dataset LIKE "dns*"
    and observer.hostname is not null 
    and not (COALESCE(source.ip IN ("0.0.0.0","255.255.255.255"), false) OR COALESCE(destination.ip in ("0.0.0.0","255.255.255.255"), false)
)
    and dns.question.type is not null and dns.question.type != "PTR"
| stats COUNT() by source.ip, dns.status_code, destination.domain, dns.question.type
| stats COUNT() by destination.domain  
| rename destination.domain as Query,`COUNT()` as Count
| sort Count desc
| limit 10
| keep Query, Count
